name: Homura Kyou
source:
Her parents died early in life, and she has been the proprietress of a hot spring inn, Homura, since her twenties.

In front of Ippei and Ryouko, she speaks in an older sisterly manner. she can be a bit rough around the edges, but once in front of customers, she shows her perfect customer service with a calm and composed manner. She is also a karate expert, and even though he has retired from karate, he can still cut a beer bottle with her hand. So, although she could actually twist Tetsuji with one hand, she held back for fear that he might cause a serious injury to the young Ippei. Besides, she didn't want to raise her hand to a man she had fallen in love with.

For whatever reason, she feels a little sad for Ippei, who has suddenly become withdrawn since he entered junior high school. She is also intensely frustrated by the lack of men in her life since her husband vanished ten years ago. Although she does not drown herself in it, she has a few adult toys hidden in the back of the mirror drawer.

Her weakness is alcohol, and the mere smell of it makes her weak. On the day she accidentally drinks, her personality does a 180-degree turn and she becomes a crying baby.
